description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging pipeline, passing along only message data by suppressing metadata such as priority, tag, and throwable details. It provides methods to set and get the next LogNode in the chain, supporting chaining of log processing.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that removes all log metadata except the message, used in logging chains for simplified message output.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message by passing only the message content to the next node, suppressing other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log messages are sent.
